item.title: Re: The School Boiler Room (Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
is altering the minds of the students around it as well as young adults and forcing them to perform cult like acts against their will or knowledge

what are 'cult like acts'?

I guess, at the end of the day, my biggest concern with this is that it feels like it has a lot of moving parts and complexity to it but none of the narrative really goes anywhere: it feels like this is all setting for a cool story but I really want to see what the cool story actually is, y'know? I want to see how the Foundation struggles with this, I want to see where their struggle leads them, I want to see how all the elements come together to really convey the sense of horror you're aiming for, y'know?

item.title: The School Boiler Room (Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
A strange boiler room on a school campus who manipulates the minds of the youth to exhibit strange cult like behavior

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: It will be the standard SCP format. It's less like containment and more like surveillance and testing, as they can not permanently disable the abilities of it. The addendums at the bottom will include an interview with a student, an agent who has had contact, and the negotiations with the local government about it being on school grounds (With the possibility that SCP-XXXX is manipulating them too).

Elevator Pitch: A boiler room in the center of a high school ground is altering the minds of the students around it as well as young adults and forcing them to perform cult like acts against their will or knowledge. This provides a unique challenge for the foundation as they have to prevent this from spreading but also keeping it a secret.

Central Narrative: The SCP foundation has found out about this anomaly after several reports from parents concerned about their children's behavior. They find out it's caused by the boiler room, and attempt to prevent it's abilities but are unable to. They are forced to disguise as construction workers and set up sensors all around the Boiler Room. They discover that when nobody or when only young people are near, it attempts to spread. Protrusions were found as well as insects with the same anomalous nerve patterns as the young people flying away at night, forcing the foundation to physically remove the nests and protrusions from the building.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Although similar to SCP-015, there are no truly physical properties about the building that signify it's strangeness. There have been smells and sounds with no source deriving from the building. It takes place during school grounds, which provides an interesting challenge as well as a basis for tales I wish to write from the student's or agent's perspective of this SCP. If I can get a more scientific reviewer I can go further into details about the science (more like sci-fi-ence) of what is happening to these students and tested agents.

Additional Notes: I have a working draft, I just need this green light. If you would like to see the link to the sandbox, I can provide it. I know this is my first story posted but I've been working on this idea for over a year now and would love to see it come to light as a real SCP. Thanks for reading!
